component.name: M3UTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return
http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(url) http.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.InitClientCertificates() http.AddHeader("User-Agent", "Roku/1.0")
resp = http.GetToString() code = http.GetResponseCode()
if code < 200 or code >= 300 m.top.result = {error: "HTTP " + str(code).trim()} return end if
rs = CreateObject("roString") rs.SetString(resp) lines = rs.Tokenize(chr(10))
channels = [] groups = [] groupsSeen = {} maxCh = 3000 extinf = ""
for each rawLine in lines if channels.count() >= maxCh then exit for line = rawLine if Right(line, 1) = chr(13) line = Left(line, Len(line) - 1) end if line = Trim(line) if line <> "" if Left(line, 7) = "#EXTINF" extinf = line else if Left(line, 1) <> "#" and extinf <> "" ch = parseExtinf(extinf) ch.url = line channels.push(ch) g = ch.group if g = "" then g = "Uncategorized" if not groupsSeen.doesExist(g) groupsSeen[g] = true groups.push(g) end if extinf = "" end if end if end for
m.top.result = { _isM3U : true, _groups : groups, _channels : channels } end sub
function parseExtinf(line as String) as Object ch = {name: "", group: "", logo: ""} commaPos = 0 k = Len(line) while k > 1 if Mid(line, k, 1) = "," commaPos = k k = 1 end if k = k - 1 end while if commaPos > 0 ch.name = Trim(Mid(line, commaPos + 1, Len(line) - commaPos)) end if ch.group = extractAttr(line, "group-title") ch.logo = extractAttr(line, "tvg-logo") return ch end function
function extractAttr(line as String, attr as String) as String needle = attr + "=" + chr(34) pos = Instr(1, line, needle) if pos = 0 then return "" s = pos + Len(needle) e = Instr(s, line, chr(34)) if e = 0 then return "" return Mid(line, s, e - s) end function
